$comment: Hand-curated availability that PokeAPI does not model. Species are PokeAPI slugs; build-data.mjs fails on unknown slugs. Review when HOME or GO add content.

notes.celebi: Special Research "A Ripple in Time" (follows Mew's research).
notes.jirachi: Special Research "A Thousand-Year Slumber"; availability has varied.
notes.meltan: Mystery Box (ongoing). Your first GO → HOME transfer also gives a Melmetal.
notes.melmetal: Evolve Meltan with 400 candy. Your first GO → HOME transfer also gives a Melmetal.

Shiny Meltan for completing HOME's Let's Go Kanto dex.
Shiny Volcanion for completing HOME's Lumiose, Hyperspace and Mega Evolution dexes.
